entities.summary: Lyonpo Khandu Wangchuk is a political figure in Bhutan. He graduated from St. Stephen's College, University of Delhi. He was Chairman of the council from 2001 until 2002. On 7 September 2006, he became Prime Minister again; he was then replaced by Kinzang Dorji on 2 August 2007, after Wangchuk resigned to participate in the 2008 election as a member of the Druk Phuensum Tshogpa (DPT) political party. He also served as Minister of Foreign Affairs from 2003 to 2007. Khandu Wangchuk was a political leaders from Paro District (b. 1950-11-24, Paro District). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Khandu Wangchuk's tenure as Prime Minister from 2006 to 2007 had a moderate impact on Bhutan's politics, following his previous term from 1998 to 2003. His resignation paved the way for Kinzang Dorji's leadership.
